First-load JS per route, gzip level 9, in bytes. Updated for the 2 October JTBD controls after CI measured the built routes: role recovery and filters, company scan/Health actions, applications, Learning, and the Library evidence/conflict editor. The saved manual role route reuses RolesTable's review and CV controls; its measured 127,499 B gets a 132,000 B route limit with about 3% headroom. The application CV workspace measures 129,842 B after lazy Refine and Manual controls; its 138,000 B limit matches the existing CV detail route.
